asset.description:
Identity lock: the main subject must remain the referenced virtual avatar from reference_character_ids/reference_videos; preserve its species, face, body, color, and overall appearance. Do not replace it with a human unless the user explicitly asks.

Product reference: image_1 (LuminaSilk — sleek cylindrical glass bottle, brushed rose-gold cap, semi-translucent amber liquid, minimalist embossed logo — exactly as shown in image_1)
Figure 1: a California-girl lifestyle model with healthy sun-kissed skin, slim curvy figure, bright vacation-ready look (via reference_character_ids)

Spoken language: English. Visual Tone: photorealistic 35mm cinematic commercial, naturally matte sun-kissed skin with absolutely no greasy highlights, soft diffused illumination, 5500K natural-sun colour temperature, documentary-grade realistic human skin texture.

[00-03s] Figure 1 walks forward confidently on a sunlit urban street, casually tosses the LuminaSilk sleek cylindrical glass bottle (matching image_1 — rose-gold cap, amber liquid) toward camera. Fast zoom-in as the bottle fills the frame. Bullet-time visual effect: motion freezes, a circular light arc sweeps the bottle. Reverse physics — bottle flies back into Figure 1's palm. She grins at camera.

[03-07s] Whip-pan cut to a polished marble studio desktop. LuminaSilk bottle from image_1 center-frame, gift box and accessories arranged around it. Slow macro tilt-up showcasing surface textures, amber liquid, rose-gold cap. A minimal floating label with '$89 – Limited Launch Price | 50% OFF Today Only' appears.

[07-12s] Three-quarter tracking shot of Figure 1 in motion. Rapid match-cut transitions cycle through four vivid environments — beach, retro street, neon city, resort garden — at strobe speed. LuminaSilk bottle (image_1) is a fixed anchor in every frame, held by Figure 1. Beat-synced edit.

[12-15s] Hard cut to full-screen product landing poster. LuminaSilk bottle and gift box on marble, static wide shot. Bold text: '$89 – Limited Launch Price | 50% OFF Today Only' and 'Weightless Hydration All Day | Engineered for Perfection.' No person visible, clean premium aesthetic.

Audio: up-tempo commercial EDM building from 0s, heavy sub-bass boom at bullet-time freeze (~3s), rapid stutter and shutter-click during match-cuts (7-12s), crisp punchy pop beat at ending (12-15s)., Photorealistic 35mm cinematic commercial, naturally matte skin texture, soft diffused 5500K lighting, vivid authentic product colours, luxury beauty commercial aesthetic, high-end fashion photography quality
